title: Add d.data's commit-signing key to team/keys.json in PrompTugal__News__Data, so its waiting work can reach dev
why: The commit adds one entry: data-d-ssh-signing, Ed25519, fingerprint sha256:bda3050f6f0f0716, principals data.d@AgentiCCells.dinis and data.d@PrompTugal.dinis. It is signed by that new key, so scripts/check-signatures.mjs refuses it (control 2: keys come from the parent commit). Until a listed key (or a person) adds it, the commits on branch data-d/pending cannot reach dev: Dinis's streaming-pages decision and proposal, the Strictly and football sources, the Wikipedia feed (33 of 33 articles) and the connections, which data.open.d takes over (D13).
checks: signatures: pass for every later commit on data-d/pending; this commit fails by design (its key is not in its parent's keys.json)
options: a) data.b@ commits the one team/keys.json entry from data-d/key, signed with its listed key (data.b-ssh-signing), relayed by the conductors; d.data then rebases data-d/pending on dev and pushes to dev
b) wait for factory.d's key-request pipeline (work/factory.d-key-requests, 3b83da3), Dinis's standing route of 22 Nov 13:39 UTC, which is not live yet
c) Dinis commits the entry himself
